title: Velvet Pumpkin & Truffle Soup
desc: Warm morning light streams through a timber-framed stone window, bathing a weathered terracotta tabletop. In a hand-thrown ceramic bowl, a velvety roasted pumpkin bisque is elevated with a slow, hypnotic spiral of fresh cream, toasted pumpkin seeds, and delicate shavings of black winter truffle.
businessBrief: The organic interplay of rustic textures, natural directional light, and the slow pour dynamics of fresh cream establishes an authentic farm-to-table luxury mood. Designed for heritage culinary brands, organic CPG producers, and seasonal restaurant campaigns.
